name: Cunobelinus

attributes.attribute: ruled the Catuvallauni for forty years
Shakespeare's tragic figure based on him

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cunobelinus was a warrior of southern Britain. He led the Catuvallauni for forty years, until the force of Rome arrived. Shakespeare later drew the matter of his tragic Cymbeline from this leader.

okr.objective: Cunobelinus is a British hero whose reign of forty years closed with the Roman invasion.
key_results: He led the Catuvallauni for four decades.
His power ended when the arms of Romans came.
Shakespeare made him the seed of the character.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
